title: Cloud and AWS fundamentals
summary: Build the mental model every AWS interview assumes: what cloud computing is, who owns which security tasks, how control and data planes differ, how services group by job, and how billing and resource limits work before you touch a Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) or Identity and Access Management (IAM) policy.

topics.title: Shared responsibility model (security of the cloud vs in the cloud)
Control plane versus data plane (who configures vs who serves traffic)
AWS service map (compute, storage, networking, security)
Billing, quotas, and resource limits (pay for what you use)
